title: Recombination Lines and Molecular Gas from Hypercompact H II regions in W51 A
question: What are the physical properties, ionized-gas kinematics and molecular-gas kinematics of compact (hypercompact) HII regions in W51 A?

data.bands: VLA Ku-band (2 cm); ALMA lines near 218-232 GHz
data.arrays: ALMA 12m array, two configurations; VLA D and B configurations
data.angular_resolution: H30alpha beam 0.32"x0.31"; all RL/continuum images convolved to 0.40"
data.sensitivity: H30alpha rms about 3.53 mJy/beam per channel; 2-cm continuum rms about 50 uJy/beam

what.value: Catalog of cm-continuum sources in W51 A used for source selection

evidence.quote: We first impose a size cut to the catalog of (cite: Ginsburg16)

what.value: Molecular-line cubes (H2CO, SO) from ALMA data release

evidence.quote: We also use the molecular-line cubes from the data release of (cite: Ginsburg17).

what.value: Atomic and molecular line parameters from Splatalogue, mainly CDMS

evidence.quote: We retrieved atomic and molecular parameters from *Splatalogue*[^1], mainly taking the laboratory measurements from the Cologne Database for Molecular Spectroscopy (CDMS)

recipe.method: Size cut radii<1" on Ginsburg16 catalog gives catalog A (29); sources within ALMA field give catalog B (20)

recipe.goal: Measure sizes, fluxes, optical depths, EM, ne, Lyman rate from 2-cm continuum
recipe.method: Interactive 2D Gaussian fits; background-subtracted flux; brightness temperature, tau, EM, ne,c, Lc from equations

recipe.goal: Extract RL spectra and derive broadening and ne,RL
recipe.method: Spectra from 2sigma aperture, scaled by 1/0.95; Gaussian fits; thermal, dynamical, pressure broadening via Voigt; ne from GM12 eq. A.4

recipe.goal: Classify molecular line profiles for infall/expansion
recipe.method: Extract H2CO and SO spectra in same apertures; qualitative profile classification (blue/red-peaked, inverse P-Cygni); compare with H30alpha centroid

answer_key.quantity: Deconvolved diameter of sources with valid fits

evidence.quote: We derive diameters for 10/20 sources in the range $D \sim 10^{-3}$ to $\sim 10^{-2}$ pc
electron densities are of order $n_{\rm e, c} \sim 10^4$ to $10^5$ cm$^{-3}$
The velocity differences range from $\Delta v_{77-30} \approx - 1$ to $- 4$ km s$^{-1}$  for all sources except for d2

answer_key.value: 3 of 8 embedded HC HII (e2, e3, e4)

evidence.quote: we have 3 out of 8 HC HII’s (e2, e3, e4) whose local molecular gas appears to have bulk infall motions

not_stated_but_needed: ALMA calibration and imaging details (CASA version, robust, continuum subtraction) are only in Ginsburg17
Exact aperture positions and background ring radii for flux extraction
Velocity ranges used for baseline fitting
missing_for_reproduction: Reduced cubes from Ginsburg17 data release
score_reason: Analytic equations are given, but data reduction is deferred to earlier papers and many extraction details are missing.
rediscovery_reason: Public data, equations and numeric tables are given, though processed cubes are needed.
